<śuddhipatrikā>

|| śrīḥ|| || śrīsadāśivamūrtaye namaḥ || [hariharatāratamyaprāraṃbhaḥ]
vṛddhān śrutismṛtipurāṇaviśeṣabhāṣān niḥśaṃkabuddhikuśalān praṇipatya nityam || advaitamekamabhajaṃ śritabhedabuddhiḥ pṛcchāmyaṃhaṃ hariharasthitatāratamyam || 1||
ekaḥ samudrasalile vaṭapatraśāyī tvanyaḥ samudraśaradhistripuraprabhede || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 2||
sthitakaṃdareṣu || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 6||
ekaḥ sahastrakamalairyamupārcya tasthāvanyastu tairupacitaḥ saha modate sma || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 7 ||
gāḍhāṃdhakāraghananīlaśarīra eko jyotsnātinirmalaviśuddhaśarīra anyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 8 ||
ekaḥ kumāramabhajatsutarāmanaṃgamanyaḥ prayāti kila śaktidharaṃ kumāram || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 9||
strīrūpamāpa kila pūrvamabhīṣṭamekastvanyastamevamabhajatpuruṣasya ratyā || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 10||
muṣṇāti vallavagṛhe navanītamekastvanyo dadāti sudhiyāṃ paramāmṛtaṃ tat || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 11||
ekaḥ prayāti hi sakāma iti prasiddhimanyo tathā nihatakāma iti prasiddhim || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāḥ || 12||
ekasya jāta iti saṃtatalokavārtā nānyasya tādṛśavidūṣitadoṣavārtā || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 13 ||
ekasya vārdhuṣikajīvanavṛttirāsīdanyasya cāpi bahubhāgyadavṛttirāsīt || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 14 ||
ekastu vāṇagatimetya kvaravaṇo'dya(?) tvanyo'kṣipatyurajayāya(?) tameva vāṇama || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ saṃtya vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 15||
eko vibhāti ravicaṃdramayadvinetrastvanyo ravīṃduśikhirūpaghanatrinetraḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 16||
ekaḥ sadā savitṛmaṃḍalamadhyavartī cānyaḥ sadā savitṛdaṃtabhidāpaṭīyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 17||
ekastu dīnamajarakṣaṇadattabuddhistvanyastu mattagajaśikṣaṇadattabuddhiḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 18 ||
gopālakatvamadhigamya vibhāti caikastvanyo vṛṣādhipatināyaka ityagādi || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 19 ||
brahmāṇamāpa nijanābhisaroja eko'nyo brahmaṇo nakhamukhena śiraścakarta || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 20||
viśvaikadeśavasatirmudameti caiko viśveśvaro'yamiti yāti hi kīrtimanyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 21 ||
eko'sti keśava iti prathitastu loke'nyo vyomakeśa iti yāti jagatprasiddhim || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 22||
ekaḥ samakṣyudaharannijamabjapūrtyai tvanyastadā nayanamasya dadau ca cakram || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 23 ||
eko hyagādhalubdabdhivajale(?) nimamaḥ(?) kailāsaśailaśikhare khalu vartate'nyaḥ | ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 24 ||
ekaḥ surairupagiraṃ hi tapaścakāra tasmai dadau sutamadhikṣiti sāṃbamanyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 25 ||
ekastu nailyamupayāti śarīramātre tvanyastu nailyamupayacchati kaṃṭhamātre || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 26||
ekaḥ prasiddhimiha dhenuvadhaṃ vidhāya vyāghraṃ nihatya nitarāmitaraḥ prasiddhaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 27||
ekaḥ sadāṣṭamahiṣīrupayāti śīghramanyo bibharti nitarāmapi cāṣṭamūrtim || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 28 ||
ekaḥ suvarṇavasanaṃ vidadhāti kaṭyāmanyaḥ suvarṇagiricāpamadhātkarāgre || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 29||
eko davau śirasi barhiṇapicchamātramanyo mayūravaravāhanaputradṛṣṭiḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 30||
eko dadhāti hṛdi kaustubharatnamekamanyaḥ sahasraphaṇiratnamahīṃdrahāram || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 31||
iṃdrānujatvata upeṃdra itīḍya eka iṃdrādibhiḥ suragaṇaiḥ paripūjyate'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 32||
lakṣmīṃ vahannapi ca vāṃchati vittameko bhikṣāmaṭannapi ca yacchati bhāgyamanyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 33||
ekaḥ kareṇa dhṛtavāniha pāṃcajanyamanyastathaiva bahuviśvasṛjaḥ kapālam || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 34||
ekastu mādhava iti prathitaḥ svanāmnā tvanyo hyumādhava iti prathitaḥ svanāmnā || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 35||
vṛṃdāvane carati gobhirupetya caiko tvanyo bhṛśaṃ pitṛvanecaratīha bhūtaiḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 36||
ekaḥ kadāpi madhumātrahṛtiṃ cakāra tvanyo mahāviṣahṛtiṃ ca tathā cakāra || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 37||
ekastu kaiṭabhavadhe nipuṇastathaivamanyastu mṛtyuhanane nipuṇo nitāṃtam || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 38||
eko vrajeṣu kurute mṛduveṇunādamanyo layeṣu kurute vikaṭāṭṭahāsam || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 39||
pakṣīṃdravāhana iti prathito'yamekastvanyo ya(?)hokṣavaravāhana ityabhāṇi || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 40||
ekastu yonija iti hyagamatprasiddhimanyastvajāta iti yāti jagatprasiddhim || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 41||
ekastvanitya iti suprathito jagatyāmanyastu nitya iti śaṃsati lokasiddhiḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 42||
eko śrulūkhalanibaddha iti prasiddhastvanyo vimuktabhavapāśa iti prasiddhaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 43 ||
ekastu pārtharathavājikṛtopacārastvanyastu pārthasamarapraṇutaprabhāvaḥ|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 44||
eko janārdana iti prakaṭīkṛto'yamanyastu śaṃkara iti sphuṭamīḍyate sma || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 45||
bhaktaṃ baliṃ punaradhaḥkṛtavānihaiko bhaktaṃ kuberamadhikaśriyamādhṛto'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 46||
vyādhādinīcahṛtanaijavadhūka eko vyādhāyito'pi nigamairabhirāśrito'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 47||
ekasya sevakajanā bhṛśadagdhagātrā hyanyasya sevakajanāḥ savibhūtirekhāḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 48||
eko dadhau sitapṛdaṃ tilakaṃ lalāṭe tvanyo dadhau hutavahaṃ tilakaṃ lalāṭe | ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 49||
eko dadhāti tulasīkṛtamālikāṃ hṛdyanyo dadhāviti vidhātṛkapālamālām || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 50||
gopālakairanusṛtaḥ sutarāmihaiko dikpālakairanusṛtastu digaṃbaro'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 51 ||
eko milatyanu (* *? * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *) || vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 52||
eko mṛgābhilaṣito gahane cacāra hyanyo mṛgaṃ karatalena vahaṃścacāra || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 53||
eko daśāsyahṛtanaijavadhūka āsīdanyo vadhūvilasitārdhaśarīra āsīt || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 54||
ekastu śailanicayaiḥ śaradhiṃ vavaṃdha hyanyastameva śaradhiṃ tripure cakāra || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 55 ||
ekastu markaṭabhaṭena dadāha laṃkāṃ hyanyaḥ kareṇa ca dadāha puratrayaṃ tat || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 56||
ekastu markaṭabhaṭairnijakāryakārī hyanyaḥ suredranivahairnijakāryakārī || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 57||
eko viveśa(?) sarayūsalilāṃtarāle tvanyo dadhau tripathagāṃ kaṇavajjaṭāyām|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 58||
ekaḥ śivaṃ jagati pūjayati sma setau rāmeśvaro'dya tu janaiḥ paridṛśyate'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 59 ||
ekastu matsyatanumetya gato'bdhitoye hyanyastu matsyakalitadhvajadhak prasiddhaḥ|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 60||
eko nṛsiṃhatanumetya jaghāna daityamanyastameva hatavān śarabhāvatāre || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 61||
eko baṭuḥ kapaṭa ityakhilairabhāṇi vidyāgurustvapara ityakhilairabhāṇi || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 62||
eko'pi cauryahatavāniha tāṭakāṃ strīmanyo jaghāna hi madāṃdhakarākṣaseṃdram || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 63||
(* * * * * * * * * * * * * *?) ye'pi hi cāsti śaktiḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayāmāśrayāmaḥ || 64||
ekaḥ prasiddha iha saṃprati vāsudevo devo mahāniti sadā ca tataḥ prasiddhaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 65 ||
ekaḥ padena śakaṭaṃ sahasā nunoda hyanyaḥ padāṃgulinakhena giriṃ nunoda || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 66 ||
ekaḥ padatrayamitaṃ trijagaccakāra hyanyaḥ padāhatihataṃ trijagaccakāra || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 67||
ekasya rūpamadhigacchati tāmasatvamanyasya rūpamadhigacchati sātvikatvam || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 68||
nīlo'pi nīlayamunājalamagna ekaḥ śubhro'pi śubhrataradivyadhunīdharo'nyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 69||
ekasya sūnurapi netrakṛśānudagdho hyanyasya vatsa uditaḥ khalu śāśvatāyuḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 70||
eko varāhatanumetya bhuvaṃ vilekha hyanyo bhuvaṃ purajaye svarathīcakāra || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 71||
eko calāṃ nijavadhūṃ na śaśāka roddhamanyaścakāra vanitāṃ sphuṭamardhamātre || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 72||
eko vibhāti nitarāṃ śikhipicchacūḍastvanyo vibhāti nitarāṃ navacaṃdramauliḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 73 ||
ekasya sūkarajaniḥ sulabhāsti hīnā hyanyasya ceccharabharūpamatiprasiddham || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 74 ||
eko vibhāti bhṛśamekamukhāṃbujena hyanyo vibhāti bhuvipaṃcamukhaiḥ prasiddhaiḥ|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 75||
ekaścaturbhuja iti prathitastrilokyāmanyo bhṛśaṃ daśabhujaiḥ prathito jagatyām || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 76||
paṃcāyudhaprabalaśaktimupaiti caikaḥ sarvāyudhaprabalaśaktimupaiti cānyaḥ|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 77 ||
eko mumūrccha gahane ca kirātavāṇādanyo hyamūrcchaya durutripurasthadaityān || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 78||
ekastu cakramadhigamya rarakṣa lokāṃścakrapradaḥ puraripuḥ suracakravartī || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 79||
ekastripāditi bhṛśaṃ jagati prasiddho hyanyasya sevakajano'pi tadā prasiddhaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 80||
ekastu sādhu hayavaktra iti prasiddho hyanyasya putra ibhavaktra iti prasiddhaḥ|| ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 81||
ekasya bhāti caturānana eva sūnuranyasya bhāti hi ṣaḍānana eva sūnuḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 82 ||
ādāya vedamadiśadvidhaye puraiko'nyo vedavājiṣu vidhiṃ vidadhe sa sūtam || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 83 ||
eko jaghāna narakaṃ sutarāmihaikamanyo jaghāna narakānsutarāmanekān || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ|| 84||
ekastu yācakabaliṃ ca punaryayāca hyanyo dadāviha paratra ca saukhyameva || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 85 ||
grāhaṃ nihatya karirājamarakṣadeko mṛtyuṃ nihatya muniputramarakṣadanyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 86||
ekaḥ papau stanarasaṃ viṣatīvravegamanyaḥ papau bhuvanabhīkarakālakūṭam ||(?) ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 87||
bhaktena kenacidabaṃdhayadabdhimeko bhaktena kenacidapītayadabdhimanyaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 88 ||
eko'vadhīdripugaṇaṃ ca kṛtāvatāraḥ śatrūn jayeti ca paraḥ samadādanujñām || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāyaśrāmaḥ || 89 ||
eko'rjunasya jayadaḥ khalu sūtabhāvādanyo'rjunasya jayado'bhavadastradānāt || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 90 ||
eko vyadhāttṛṇamivādrivaraṃ sumeruṃ govardhanādrimitarastu kare dadhānaḥ || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 91 ||
ekaṃ dvijātimakhileṣu sureṣu madhye kṣatraṃ paraṃ tu paramārthavido vadaṃti || ko vānayoradhika ityanuciṃtya vṛddhāḥ satyaṃ vadaṃtu tamimaṃ vayamāśrayāmaḥ || 92 ||
advaitameva bhajanīyamato'prameyaṃ nityaṃ niraṃjanamanākṛtinirvikalpam || satyaṃ parātparamakhaṃḍacidātmabhāvamānaṃdyamacyutamajaṃ tamihāśrayāmaḥ || 93||
[śrīkāṃtanāmavibudheṃdratanūbhavena rāmeśvarādhyarasudhāmaṇinā praṇītam || loke tvidaṃ hariharasthitatāratamyaṃ matvādhikaṃ hi śatakaṃ sudhiyaḥ paṭhaṃtu] || 94 ||
|| [iti hariharatāratamyaṃ samāptam] ||
